Interface BotOpponent

public interface BotOpponent
A bot body spawned by a BotProvider for one round. The core calls every method on the main thread.

  • Method Details

    • getPlayer

      org.bukkit.entity.Player getPlayer()
      The live body. Its UUID equals the entity id passed to BotProvider.spawn(UUID, Location, BotOptions).
      Returns:
      The body, never null

    • tick

      void tick(BotFightView view)
      Run one tick of bot behavior. Called once per server tick during the start countdown and while the round is live (see BotFightView.isLive()), and never otherwise. Throwing an exception ends the match.
      Parameters:
      view - The current round state

    • pause

      void pause()
      Stop all inputs and item use, keeping the current momentum. Called at round end and after a death.

    • idle

      default void idle()
      Run one tick of physics with no input while the bot is not fighting (round end). Called once per server tick instead of tick(BotFightView). Defaults to pause().

    • show

      void show(org.bukkit.entity.Player viewer)
      Show the body to a fighter or spectator.
      Parameters:
      viewer - The viewer

    • hide

      void hide(org.bukkit.entity.Player viewer)
      Hide the body from a viewer. Also called for viewers who went offline.
      Parameters:
      viewer - The viewer

    • remove

      void remove()
      Remove the body. Called when the round or match ends; must be safe to call more than once.
